what_is_section.title: What is Managed Farmland?
what_is_section.description: Managed farmland is a revolutionary investment model that offers you direct ownership of agricultural land without the complexities of farming it yourself. EarthFoundation acts as your expert steward, handling everything from soil preparation to harvest, while you enjoy the benefits of land ownership and agricultural returns.

technologies.title: Cutting-Edge Agricultural Technology
technologies.description: We leverage the latest in agricultural technology to maximize yields and ensure sustainable farming practices.

list.title: Drip Irrigation Systems
list.description: Delivering water directly to the roots, saving up to 70% water while ensuring optimal plant hydration.

list.title: IoT Soil Sensors
list.description: Providing real-time data on moisture and nutrient levels for precise care and optimal growing conditions.

list.title: Drone Monitoring
list.description: Offering an aerial view for crop health assessment and security surveillance across all farm areas.

list.title: Data Analytics
list.description: Using advanced data analytics to predict yields, prevent diseases, and maximize your return on investment.

crops.title: Premium Crop Selection
crops.description: We carefully select high-value crops that offer the best combination of market demand, growth potential, and sustainable cultivation.

list.name: Sandalwood (Santalum album)
list.description: Known as 'Liquid Gold,' Indian Sandalwood is a globally prized commodity with ever-increasing demand and limited supply. It's the ultimate long-term asset, promising exceptional, generational wealth upon its 12-15 year harvest cycle.

list.name: Butter Fruit (Avocado)
list.description: A popular superfood with high and consistent market demand. Butter fruit cultivation provides quicker revenue streams within 3-4 years, ensuring a balanced portfolio with regular cash flow while your legacy Sandalwood crop matures.
